% Shared normative requirements, crosswalk, and falsifiable predictions.
\section{Normative conformance requirements}\label{sec:requirements}

An implementation conforms to one requirement only when the exact records and
states named by that requirement are present and valid. A finite numerical
value does not substitute for a missing identity, authority, or state.

\small
\begin{longtable}{@{}p{0.20\linewidth}p{0.52\linewidth}p{0.20\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
Requirement & Normative statement & Scientific source \\
\midrule
\endhead
SCI-POINT-REQ-001 & Treat every requested observation-array-parent-method fit as an independent value-or-status scientific atom; keep its stage records distinct; and require only the POINT completeness/publication decision for base fit completion, not successful downstream named-use decisions. & Secs.~\ref{sec:operation}, \ref{sec:input-record} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-002 & Bind every stage-specific record field in Section~\ref{sec:input-record}, including inherited parent observation/exposure lineage or typed \path{not_applicable}; POINT creates no exposure identity, and no identity is inferred from filenames, labels, location, or later-stage facts. & Sec.~\ref{sec:input-record} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-003 & Admit only exact MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, or FLT-MATCHED signal roles and preserve their distinct meanings and companions. & Sec.~\ref{sec:routes} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-004 & Never automatically select, substitute, equate, or fall back among parent routes. & Sec.~\ref{sec:routes} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-005 & Treat FRUIT only as complete terminal ancestry on one admitted route; reject intermediate iterations and coadds. & Sec.~\ref{sec:routes} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-006 & Bind the exact parent-response identity/status, possibly typed unavailable, plus processed profile, Gaussian compatibility, response center, model mismatch, centroid-bias state, and claim status; require a numerical response only when the approved method or claim depends on it. & Secs.~\ref{sec:input-record}, \ref{sec:routes} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-007 & Bind expected source position, parent WCS origin, search center, and fitted centroid as four distinct objects. & Secs.~\ref{sec:input-record}, \ref{sec:displacement} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-008 & Use the exact ordered AltAz tangent basis, physical metric, transform, handedness, positive directions, state, support, uncertainty, and provenance. & Eqs.~\ref{eq:transform}--\ref{eq:displacement} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-009 & Publish displacement only as fitted centroid minus expected position in arcseconds; do not encode correction sign. & Eq.~\ref{eq:displacement} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-010 & Use only the zero-background six-role elliptical-Gaussian family in Equation~\ref{eq:gaussian}; add no background or second model family. & Sec.~\ref{sec:model} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-011 & Preserve the invariant positive-definite shape, canonical principal ordering, and symmetry-defined orientation state without inventing numerical width or angle conventions. & Sec.~\ref{sec:model} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-012 & Produce no numerical fit or fit-derived product until the approved compatibility method, exact parent, and route binding are available. & Sec.~\ref{sec:method-authorities} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-013 & Keep objective, exact consumed $W_{\mathrm{fit}}$, uniform/reliability/covariance/inverse-covariance source roles, stochastic covariance, formal-error model, and parent uncertainty distinct; bind every approved weight derivation's identity, units, normalization, support, state, ceiling, and provenance; never guess Equation~\ref{eq:conditional-fit}. & Secs.~\ref{sec:conditional-fit}, \ref{sec:fit-weights} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-014 & Use the exact producer lifecycle in Section~\ref{sec:input-record}; distinguish the frozen resolved plan from its application attempt and realized fit, and preserve every search, support, fallback, retry, constraint, sentinel, and termination state. & Secs.~\ref{sec:input-record}, \ref{sec:conditional-fit} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-015 & Establish source association independently for every authorized search, fallback, restart, and retry branch before creating any source-associated displacement, amplitude, or intended-source diagnostic. & Sec.~\ref{sec:association} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-016 & Carry \path{known}, \path{isolated}, \path{bright}, and \path{approximately_centered} applicability as typed facts with authority, domain, cause, validity, lifecycle, and provenance. & Sec.~\ref{sec:applicability} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-017 & When fitting is authorized, place selected seed, fitted values, association outcome, realized constraints, model/residual, objective, support, row count, rank, convergence, branch, diagnostics, and additive-reference/null state only in the applicable post-request records and publish or make them reconstructible. & Secs.~\ref{sec:input-record}, \ref{sec:residual} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-018 & Give every required fit component exactly one component-identifiability state and preserve available sibling components when another is unavailable or failed. & Secs.~\ref{sec:state-axes}, \ref{sec:dependencies} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-019 & Type signed numerical $A$ as \path{POINT-FIT-AMPLITUDE-COMPONENT}; create \path{POINT-SOURCE-ASSOCIATED-AMPLITUDE-DIAGNOSTIC} only after established association, with exact parent unit, calibration, response identity/status, constraint, support, and uncertainty context. & Secs.~\ref{sec:products}, \ref{sec:association} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-020 & Publish widths and angle only as processed-map effective-shape and QC roles; do not claim intrinsic beam or unique cause. & Secs.~\ref{sec:products}, \ref{sec:model} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-021 & Publish marginal formal errors only under the separately approved formal-error method with assumptions, conditioning, domain, units, and limitations. & Secs.~\ref{sec:method-authorities}, \ref{sec:uncertainty} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-022 & Represent absent joint covariance as unavailable, not zero, diagonal, or independence, and preserve later uncertainty companions as separate versions. & Sec.~\ref{sec:uncertainty} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-023 & Treat the signed roles in Equations~\ref{eq:dynamic-range}--\ref{eq:formal-standardization} as independently requested derived products with exact amplitude, method, parent, lifecycle, availability, support, unit-one, cause, provenance, association, mathematically identical alias, and claim-ceiling gates. & Sec.~\ref{sec:diagnostics} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-024 & Admit neither \texttt{peak\_over\_full\_map\_rms} nor \path{POINT-FORMAL-AMPLITUDE-MAGNITUDE-STANDARDIZATION@1} without separate request and authority; an alias requires proof of mathematical identity. & Sec.~\ref{sec:diagnostics} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-025 & Keep fixed POINT and fixed parent response, POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed response, whole-chain full-procedure response, observational bias/accuracy, and source association distinct; compare numerical outputs only under the exact comparability record. & Secs.~\ref{sec:response}, \ref{sec:response-equations} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-026 & Apply the product-and-claim dependency matrix by exact role; missing association, response, covariance, method, or downstream decision shall block only dependent products/claims and shall neither erase nor authorize amplitude, centroid, displacement, or another independent fact. & Sec.~\ref{sec:dependencies} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-027 & Bind, rather than independently redefine, the owner-authoritative SCI-VAL crosswalk; keep producer lifecycle, component identifiability, and request/applicability/eligibility/realization axes independent, including genuine absence of an applicability or eligibility proposition. & Secs.~\ref{sec:state-axes}, \ref{sec:val-function} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-028 & Use \texttt{diagnostic\_display\_only} only as a post-evaluation consumer action; never use it or \texttt{diagnostic\_only} as an axis value, producer lifecycle state, or universal flag. & Secs.~\ref{sec:state-axes}, \ref{sec:val-function} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-029 & Preserve separate policy ownership for fit completeness, displacement admission, telescope-QC admission, and source-associated photometric-transfer admission; SCI-VAL only registers and evaluates exact profiles. & Secs.~\ref{sec:ownership}, \ref{sec:profiles} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-030 & Treat all four named-use profile identities and their bound SCI-VAL mechanics, including absence-of-proposition behavior, as unapproved drafts pending final owner review; this revision neither registers nor makes them evaluable, and no aggregate/universal profile may be constructed. & Secs.~\ref{sec:profiles}, \ref{sec:val-function} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-031 & Publish no POINT cross-array aggregate, correction, correction selection, correction application, or whole-observation success. & Secs.~\ref{sec:operation}, \ref{sec:named-uses} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-032 & Do not impute a missing array or erase conforming siblings after one array's failure. & Secs.~\ref{sec:operation}, \ref{sec:named-uses} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-033 & Keep deterministic unmodeled background/structure visible as residual and parent state; do not fit or silently subtract it. & Eq.~\ref{eq:residual} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-034 & Apply every typed unavailable state, bound SCI-VAL disposition, and edge rule in Section~\ref{sec:validity}, including realized accounting artifacts for unknown applicability, artifact failure only when production fails, exact cause/release condition, reached-lifecycle preservation, and conforming siblings. & Secs.~\ref{sec:validity}, \ref{sec:val-function} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-035 & Keep all uncertainty-budget components separate and form conditional displacement covariance only by Equation~\ref{eq:displacement-covariance} with every required variance, cross-covariance, basis, and Jacobian available. & Secs.~\ref{sec:uncertainty}, \ref{sec:displacement-covariance} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-036 & Publish POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed response only after rerunning every POINT data-dependent branch, and whole-chain full-procedure response only under complete upstream rerun authority; never alias either to fixed response or multiply finite differences as Jacobians without an exact composition theorem. & Sec.~\ref{sec:response} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-037 & Evaluate each independently requested named-use child decision with the owner-bound SCI-VAL crosswalk before action; bind its immutable fit reference, profile, source facts, lifecycle, cause, and provenance without fit mutation, new fit generation, cross-use rescue, or propagation. & Secs.~\ref{sec:val-function}, \ref{sec:named-uses} \\
SCI-POINT-REQ-038 & Respect the evidence ceiling: this contract alone authorizes no implementation, numerical, fidelity, validation, accuracy, performance, readiness, production, or Unity claim. & Sec.~\ref{sec:claim-ceiling} \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
\normalsize

\section{Falsifiable predictions and traceability}\label{sec:predictions}

These predictions specify tests that a future implementation or representation
can fail. They are not claims that such validation has occurred.

\scriptsize
\begin{longtable}{@{}p{0.16\linewidth}p{0.58\linewidth}p{0.18\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
Prediction & Falsifiable consequence & Governing requirements \\
\midrule
\endhead
SCI-POINT-PRED-001 & For an exact noiseless matching Gaussian with complete admitted support, identifiable noncircular shape, parameters in the admitted interior or under the approved boundary rule, and one unique compatibility-method solution, the method recovers canonical amplitude, centroid, and invariant shape. At circularity the equal widths and invariant shape recover while orientation is symmetry-undefined; at an active bound the affected role is bound-censored under the approved constrained solution. & REQ-010,011,012,013,014,018 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-002 & Authorized scaling of the parent signal and compatible unit scales amplitude as the method declares without moving the source reference. & REQ-006,007,019 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-003 & Positive displacement follows fitted centroid minus expected position; correction sign remains downstream. & REQ-008,009,031 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-004 & Changing only the search center may change branch or seed but never measurement zero. & REQ-007,009,014 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-005 & WCS handedness or basis changes transform components through the exact boundary, independent of memory/display order. & REQ-008,009 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-006 & Central-search and global-fallback branches remain distinguishable across resolved plan, applied attempt, and realized-fit records. & REQ-001,014 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-007 & An exact score tie follows the future method's deterministic tie rule and records the selected result only after application, never in the immutable request. & REQ-002,012,014 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-008 & A wrong global peak may retain a fit-amplitude component but cannot yield source-associated displacement, amplitude, or intended-source diagnostic without established association. & REQ-015,019 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-009 & Principal-axis exchange with corresponding angle transformation leaves the Gaussian invariant. & REQ-011 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-010 & Exact circularity makes orientation undefined by model symmetry. & REQ-011,018 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-011 & Active amplitude, width, or angle constraints appear in applied and realized records; affected components are bound-censored where applicable and are not silently counted as unconstrained recovery. & REQ-014,018 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-012 & An unmodeled constant or gradient can bias fit roles and remains visible in residual/additive-reference state. & REQ-017,033 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-013 & Missing or non-finite support follows the exact future method rule, is never silently deleted, preserves only lifecycle stages actually reached, records terminal \path{unavailable}, \path{failed}, or \path{not_produced} with cause, and never fabricates \path{applied} or \path{fit_realized}. & REQ-002,014,034 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-014 & Reliability weights cannot be interpreted as inverse covariance without explicit authority. & REQ-013 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-015 & Rank deficiency, active bounds, non-positive curvature, or angle degeneracy can preserve fitted values while formal errors remain unavailable. & REQ-018,021,034 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-016 & MAP/JINC/FLT response mismatch changes compatibility or bias state and is not erased by common Gaussian naming; the exact parent-response identity/status remains recorded even when numerical response is unavailable. & REQ-003,006,025 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-017 & Parent-response asymmetry may yield typed centroid-bias state rather than assumed zero bias, while unavailable response may coexist with otherwise conforming fit, amplitude, centroid, and displacement roles. & REQ-006,025,026 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-018 & A terminal FRUIT product retains its exact terminal route and ancestry; an intermediate iteration is rejected. & REQ-005 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-019 & Failure of one array or one component preserves conforming sibling atoms and roles and produces no POINT observation-wide success. & REQ-001,018,031,032 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-020 & No input produces a POINT-owned cross-array aggregate or telescope correction. & REQ-031 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-021 & The independently requested signed dynamic-range role retains the selected amplitude sign and is unavailable for a zero, non-finite, or unavailable RMS denominator or missing claim-required association; it is not universally nonnegative. & REQ-019,023,034 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-022 & The canonical formal-standardization role equals signed $\widehat A/\sigma_A$ and never becomes statistical significance by naming; $|\widehat A|/\sigma_A$ has a distinct unadmitted identity, and aliases require exact mathematical identity. & REQ-019,021,023,024 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-023 & One fit may have distinct owner-bound SCI-VAL propositions across uses, including no applicability or eligibility proposition; \path{diagnostic_display_only} changes no producer lifecycle, axis value, or sibling use. & REQ-027,028,037 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-024 & A written missing-profile/source/scope accounting artifact yields \path{applicability_unknown}, \path{decision_unavailable}, and \path{realized}; a written structural conflict can also be \path{realized}; \path{failed} means artifact production failed, and no defective or absent artifact asserts eligibility. & REQ-027,030,034,037 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-025 & Fixed, POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed, and whole-chain full-procedure responses cannot be reported as one another; incomparable numerical outputs yield unavailability or a typed discontinuity/state transition, and no response establishes empirical accuracy. & REQ-025,036 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-026 & Missing compatibility method yields no numerical fit or fit-derived product. & REQ-012 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-027 & With compatibility fitting available but formal-error authority missing, fitted values may exist while formal errors, unsupported joint covariance, and formal standardization remain unavailable. & REQ-021,022,026 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-028 & Missing full-map-RMS authority blocks the RMS scale product, independently requested dynamic-range role, and any explicitly approved alias, not an otherwise authorized fit, fit-amplitude component, displacement, or formal error. & REQ-019,023,026 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-029 & Every search, fallback, restart, and retry branch requires exact association before source-associated amplitude, displacement, or any diagnostic claimed for the intended source. & REQ-015,019,023 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-030 & Fixed, POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed, whole-chain full-procedure, observational bias/accuracy, or covariance unavailability follows its separate release condition, preserves exact identity/status, and neither erases nor authorizes unrelated roles and claims. & REQ-006,025,026,035,036 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-031 & A downstream named-use child decision, including \path{diagnostic_display_only}, cannot rescue another use, mutate the immutable fit, create a new fit generation, or block base fit completion merely because that downstream artifact is unrequested, unavailable, incomplete, failed, or not produced. & REQ-001,028,037 \\
SCI-POINT-PRED-032 & A shared expected-source reference error contributes through the covariance and cross-covariance terms of Equation~\ref{eq:displacement-covariance}; it does not average down as independent per-array noise without explicit independence authority. & REQ-035 \\
